TARGET-017.supported: MICRO1795 explicitly identifies the BBL/Difco Phytone trademark/papaic soybean digest, with a manufacturer definition. TARGET-024.supported: The three Phytone-bearing labels are not exact aliases for the generic soy digest and are correctly retained with original source as REJECTED_LABEL. The alternative-product phrase does not identify one substance. The local material retains source75 unspecified soy digest and does not itself assert a manufacturer, formula or digestion method.
TARGET-024.ontology_challenge: MICRO181 is a mixed enzymatic soybean-flour digest. MediaDive75/1466 supply generic names/CAS but no digestion method/vendor. Guidep7 permits acid/base/enzyme peptone manufacture; p33 all-of-our-products enzymatic statement is manufacturer-scoped. Therefore exact181 cannot be inferred from label alone, nor can missing method prove a distinct nonenzymatic substance. The bounded generic partial material is feasible and no concrete wrong-ID counterexample is established. Section3 does not require an exhaustive rejected-term list in every payload; this exact review records the comparison.
TARGET-024.limits: Inherited resolving Soytone/Bacto/peptic-soy aliases, Soytone-specific nutritional-role evidence, related representatives and shared-ID counts are not approved. One exact W05-proposal MANUAL_CURATION entry remains an open existing1226 dependency, documented separately; no global inherited-evidence verdict is made.
